Form.RegisterSubtitle.Zh: 账号将直接创建在所选 CSNZ 服务端。
Form.RegisterSubtitle.En: Create an account on the selected CSNZ server.

Form.AccountHint.Zh: 输入 5–15 位英文字母或数字

Form.PasswordRule.Zh: 密码 5–15 位，不能全部为数字。

Mods.Description.Zh: 选择本次旅程的武器修复。勾选后自动保存，在下次启动游戏时加载。
Mods.Description.En: Select weapon fixes for your next game. Changes are saved automatically and applied on the next launch.

Mods.Enabled.Zh: 已勾选 · 下次启动游戏时加载 Giga Break LE。
Mods.Enabled.En: Selected · Giga Break LE will load on the next launch.

Settings.Description.En: Manage your game folder and server connection. Select weapon fixes under Weapon Mods.

Settings.PathHelp.Zh: 选择游戏根目录；误选 Bin 文件夹时会自动识别上一级。
Settings.PathHelp.En: Choose the game root folder. Selecting Bin will automatically resolve its parent folder.

Settings.Tls.Zh: 使用 TLS 加密连接（必须与服务端 SSL 设置一致）
Settings.Tls.En: Use TLS encryption (must match the server's SSL setting)

Settings.AutoServer.Zh: 打开登录器时，自动启动本地服务端
Settings.AutoServer.En: Start the local server when the launcher opens

Settings.AutoServerHelp.Zh: 仅在本机地址下生效；已有服务端将复用，不会重复启动。
Settings.AutoServerHelp.En: For loopback addresses only. An existing server is reused, not started again.

Settings.Minimize.Zh: 游戏启动后最小化登录器
Settings.Minimize.En: Minimize the launcher after starting the game

Settings.Clear.Zh: 清除已记住的账号与密码

Settings.FolderTitle.Zh: 选择 CSNZ 游戏根目录
Settings.FolderTitle.En: Choose the CSNZ game root folder

Settings.Saved.Zh: 设置已保存，下次游戏启动时生效。
Settings.Saved.En: Settings saved. Changes apply on the next game launch.

Settings.EndpointSaved.Zh: 设置已保存。服务器已切换，原账号与密码已清空，防止误发到其他服务器。
Settings.EndpointSaved.En: Settings saved. The server has changed, so the previous credentials were cleared to prevent sending them to another server.

Settings.Cleared.Zh: 已清除本登录器记住的账号和加密密码，游戏账号本身未删除。
Settings.Cleared.En: The saved account and encrypted password were cleared. The game account itself was not deleted.

Settings.Unreadable.Zh: 配置文件无法读取，本次使用默认设置；保存新设置前请检查本地配置。

Settings.DecryptFailed.Zh: 已保存的密码无法由当前 Windows 用户解密，请重新输入。
Settings.DecryptFailed.En: The current Windows user cannot decrypt the saved password. Please enter it again.

Server.ReadyOwned.Zh: 本地服务端已就绪 · 由登录器管理
Server.ReadyOwned.En: Local server ready · Managed by the launcher

Server.ReadyExisting.Zh: 服务端已就绪 · 复用现有实例
Server.ReadyExisting.En: Server ready · Using an existing instance

Server.WaitExisting.Zh: 检测到已有服务端，等待协议就绪…
Server.WaitExisting.En: Existing server detected. Waiting for the protocol…

Server.Initializing.Zh: 本地服务端正在初始化…

Server.Retry.Zh: 服务端未就绪，点击启动服务端重试
Server.Retry.En: Server not ready. Click Start server to retry.

Server.Stopping.Zh: 正在请求服务端保存并退出…
Server.Stopping.En: Asking the server to save and shut down…

Server.Stopped.Zh: 本地服务端已安全停止

Server.StoppedFeedback.Zh: 本地服务端已安全停止。

Server.GameRunning.Zh: 游戏仍在运行，请退出游戏后再停止服务端。
Server.GameRunning.En: The game is still running. Exit the game before stopping the server.

Server.ConfirmStop.Zh: 停止本登录器启动的服务端？其他已连接的玩家也会断开。
Server.ConfirmStop.En: Stop the server started by this launcher? Other connected players will also be disconnected.

Error.SelectRoot.Zh: 请选择游戏目录，或将登录器放到包含 Bin 的游戏根目录。
Error.SelectRoot.En: Choose your game folder, or place the launcher in the game root folder containing Bin.

Error.RemoteNotReady.Zh: 远程服务端未就绪，请联系服务器管理员启动。
Error.RemoteNotReady.En: The remote server is not ready. Ask its administrator to start it.

Error.AutoStartOff.Zh: 服务端未运行，请启用自动启动，或手动启动服务端。
Error.AutoStartOff.En: The server is not running. Enable automatic startup or start it manually.

Error.ServerMissing.Zh: 找不到 Server\CSNZ_Server.exe，请在启动设置中选择正确的游戏目录。
Error.ServerMissing.En: Server\CSNZ_Server.exe was not found. Choose the correct game folder in Settings.

Error.OtherServerOwned.Zh: 登录器仍管理另一个游戏目录的服务端，请先停止它再切换目录。
Error.OtherServerOwned.En: The launcher still manages a server from another game folder. Stop it before switching folders.

Error.Stdin.Zh: 无法为后台服务端保留标准输入句柄，请先安全停止服务端后重试。
Error.Stdin.En: Could not retain the background server's input handle. Stop the server safely before retrying.

Error.GameMissing.Zh: 游戏目录不正确，找不到 Bin\CSOLauncher.exe。

Error.GameRunning.Zh: 游戏已在运行，请先退出游戏后再登录。
Error.GameRunning.En: The game is already running. Exit it before signing in again.

Error.LegacyPatch.Zh: 检测到旧版 LEGuard。请先退出旧补丁启动器，不能与原生补丁同时加载。

Error.GameStart.En: The game could not be started.

Error.Account.En: Use 5–15 English letters or digits for the account name.

Error.Password.En: Use 5–15 printable ASCII characters for the password, with no spaces, double quotes or backslashes.

Error.NumericPassword.Zh: 注册密码不能全部为数字，请加入英文字母或符号。
Error.NumericPassword.En: The password cannot contain only digits. Add English letters or symbols.

Error.RemoteTls.Zh: 外部服务器注册必须启用 TLS。未加密注册仅允许本机回环地址。
Error.RemoteTls.En: Registration on a remote server requires TLS. Unencrypted registration is allowed only on loopback addresses.

Error.Banner.Zh: 目标端口不是兼容的 CSNZ 服务端。
Error.Banner.En: The selected port is not a compatible CSNZ server.

Error.ProtocolVersion.Zh: 服务端拒绝客户端版本，或返回了不支持的认证协议。
Error.ProtocolVersion.En: The server rejected the client version or returned an unsupported authentication protocol.

Error.RegisterUnknown.Zh: 未收到明确的注册结果，请勿将连接成功视为注册成功。
Error.RegisterUnknown.En: No definite registration result was received. A successful connection does not mean registration succeeded.

Error.PacketFormat.Zh: 服务端数据包格式或序号不兼容。
Error.PacketFormat.En: The server packet format or sequence is incompatible.

Registration.Success.Zh: 注册成功。账号已填入登录页，现在可以登录并启动游戏。
Registration.Success.En: Registration succeeded. Your account is filled in on the sign-in page; you can now launch the game.

Registration.Duplicate.Zh: 此账号已存在，请换一个账号，或返回登录。
Registration.Duplicate.En: This account already exists. Choose another name or return to sign in.

Registration.Limit.Zh: 此 IP 的注册数量已达到服务端上限，请联系服务器管理员。
Registration.Limit.En: This IP address has reached the server's account limit. Contact its administrator.

Registration.Account.Zh: 账号格式不符合服务端要求，请使用 5–15 位英文字母或数字。
Registration.Account.En: The account name does not meet the server's requirements. Use 5–15 English letters or digits.

Registration.Password.Zh: 密码需为 5–15 位，且不能全部为数字。
Registration.Password.En: The password must have 5–15 characters and cannot contain only digits.

Registration.Database.En: A server database operation failed. The account could not be created.

Registration.Unknown.Zh: 服务端返回了未识别的注册结果；请使用游戏内注册或联系管理员。
Registration.Unknown.En: The server returned an unrecognized registration result. Register in-game or contact the administrator.

Error.ConfirmPassword.Zh: 两次输入的密码不一致，请重新确认。
Error.ConfirmPassword.En: The passwords do not match. Please confirm your password again.

Connection.Unencrypted.Zh: 该远程服务器未使用 TLS，游戏会通过未加密连接发送登录凭据。是否仍要连接？
Connection.Unencrypted.En: This remote server does not use TLS. The game will send your credentials over an unencrypted connection. Connect anyway?

Patch.Ready.En: The Giga Break LE native patch is ready. The game will sign in using this account. If the game reports incorrect credentials, exit it and correct them here before retrying.

Error.Canceled.Zh: 操作超时或已取消，未确认成功。请检查服务端状态后再试。
Error.Canceled.En: The operation timed out or was canceled; success is not confirmed. Check the server status and retry.

Error.Tls.Zh: TLS 验证失败。请检查服务器证书、地址和 SSL 设置；不会绕过证书验证。
Error.Tls.En: TLS validation failed. Check the server certificate, address and SSL settings. Certificate validation will not be bypassed.

Error.Connection.Zh: 无法连接服务端。请检查地址、端口和服务器运行状态。
Error.Connection.En: Could not connect to the server. Check its address, port and running status.

Error.SettingsGameMissing.En: Bin\CSOLauncher.exe was not found in this folder.

Error.Host.Zh: 服务器地址无效，请填写 IP 或域名，不含协议与端口。

Error.Port.En: The port must be between 1 and 65535.

Error.StopBeforeSwitch.Zh: 请先在登录中心安全停止当前服务端，再切换目录或服务器地址。
Error.StopBeforeSwitch.En: Stop the current server safely in Login Center before changing its folder or address.

Close.Busy.Zh: 当前操作尚未结束，请稍候再关闭。
Close.Busy.En: An operation is still in progress. Please wait before closing.

Close.GameRunning.Zh: 游戏仍在运行。关闭登录器后，游戏和服务端将继续运行。确定关闭？
Close.GameRunning.En: The game is still running. Closing the launcher will leave the game and server running. Close anyway?

Error.PE.Zh: 不是有效的 PE 文件。

Error.PEBounds.En: The PE header is outside the file bounds.

Error.PE32.Zh: 需要 32 位 CSNZ 文件。

Error.Launcher32.Zh: 登录器必须运行于 x86 模式。
Error.Launcher32.En: The launcher must run in x86 mode.

Native.Preload.En: Could not preload the Giga Break LE native DLL

Native.Version.Zh: Giga Break LE DLL 版本不匹配。
Native.Version.En: Giga Break LE DLL version mismatch.

Native.Exports.En: Required Giga Break LE DLL exports are missing.

Native.ModuleMissing.Zh: 游戏中未找到预期模块。
Native.ModuleMissing.En: The expected module was not found in the game.

Native.Load.En: Could not load the native patch

Native.Timeout.En: The native patch entry point timed out. Exit the game and retry.

Native.Result.Zh: 无法读取补丁入口结果
Native.Result.En: Could not read the patch entry-point result

Native.ComponentPreload.Zh: 原生组件 DLL 预加载失败
Native.ComponentPreload.En: Could not preload the native component DLL

Native.Loader.Zh: 无法定位系统加载函数
Native.Loader.En: Could not locate the system loader function

Native.SystemPath.Zh: 无法获取系统模块路径
Native.SystemPath.En: Could not retrieve the system module path

Native.PathTransfer.Zh: 无法传递 DLL 路径
Native.PathTransfer.En: Could not transfer the DLL path

Native.PathWrite.Zh: 无法写入 DLL 路径
Native.PathWrite.En: Could not write the DLL path

Native.LoadRejected.Zh: 游戏未能加载原生组件 DLL。
Native.LoadRejected.En: The game could not load the native component DLL.

Native.BaseAddress.Zh: 原生组件 DLL 基址校验失败。
Native.BaseAddress.En: Native component DLL base-address verification failed.

Native.Arguments.Zh: 无法传递原生组件初始化数据
Native.Arguments.En: Could not transfer native component initialization data

Native.Status.Zh: 无法读取原生组件状态
Native.Status.En: Could not read native component status

Native.StatusExport.Zh: 原生组件状态入口不存在
Native.StatusExport.En: The native component status export is missing

App.AlreadyRunning.Zh: 登录器已经在运行，请切换到现有窗口。
App.AlreadyRunning.En: The launcher is already running. Switch to its existing window.

Settings.Security.Zh: 保存的密码使用 Windows 当前用户加密，自动登录不会将凭据放入命令行。同一 Windows 用户或管理员仍可能读取进程内存，请勿使用其他重要账号的密码。远程注册必须使用证书有效的 TLS 连接。
Settings.Security.En: Saved passwords are encrypted for the current Windows user. Automatic sign-in does not put credentials on the command line. The same Windows user or an administrator may still read process memory; do not reuse important passwords. Remote registration requires TLS with a valid certificate.

Dialog.Recover.Zh:
当前 CSNZ 服务端没有邮件或短信找回接口。

请联系该服务器管理员处理，登录器不会改写账号数据库或绕过密码验证。
Dialog.Recover.En:
This CSNZ server has no email or SMS password-recovery interface.

Contact the server administrator. The launcher will not edit the account database or bypass password verification.

Dialog.Help.Zh:
1. 若启用了自动启动，打开登录器会启动本地服务端；右上角 Ready 表示协议已响应。
2. 使用已有游戏账号登录，或通过注册页创建真实服务端账号。
3. 默认加载 Giga Break LE 原生补丁，可在武器模组中关闭。
4. 密码记忆仅适用于当前 Windows 用户；切换服务器会清空凭据。
5. 关闭窗口不会强行终止游戏或第三方启动的服务端。
6. 右上角 CN / EN 可立即切换语言，下次启动会记住选择。

登录器不包含游戏本体，不修改原游戏文件。首次创建角色仍在游戏内完成。
Dialog.Help.En:
1. If automatic startup is enabled, opening the launcher starts the local server. Ready means its protocol has responded.
2. Sign in with an existing game account, or create an account on the selected server using Register.
3. The Giga Break LE native patch is enabled by default. You can turn it off under Weapon Mods.
4. Saved passwords are tied to the current Windows user. Changing servers clears credentials.
5. Closing the launcher does not force-close the game or a server started by another program.
6. Use CN / EN at the top right to switch languages instantly. Your choice is remembered.

The launcher does not include the game or modify its original files. First-time character creation still takes place in-game.

Close.Confirm.Zh:
是否同时安全停止由本登录器启动的服务端？

是：保存并停止服务端，然后退出。
否：保留服务端运行，仅退出登录器。
Close.Confirm.En:
Also stop the server started by this launcher safely?

Yes: save and stop the server, then exit.
No: leave the server running and exit only the launcher.
